entities.summary: Geraldine Lee Richmond is an American chemist and physical chemist who is the Interim Vice President for Research and Innovation (VPRI) at the University of Oregon. She directs and oversees the university's entire research enterprise. She is committed to enhancing research excellence and strengthening the role or research, scholarship, and creative activity across the university. Before her appointment as VPRI, she served as the Under Secretary of Energy for Science in the US Department of Energy from 2021 to 2025.
